description: Why: stale Prometheus labels skew dashboards and alert rules by showing old groups as still active. What: group_metrics.rs sample_group_metrics returns Ok(HashSet::new()) when cardinality exceeds HIGH_CARDINALITY_LIMIT. The caller (run_group_metrics_sampler) only updates prev_groups on Ok. Because the returned set is empty, prev_groups is not updated, so prev_groups retains all labels from the last successful tick. On every subsequent tick where cardinality stays high, the stale-label removal loop in the caller never runs (because it runs the difference of new_groups minus prev_groups, and new_groups is always empty). Labels from the pre-high-cardinality era persist indefinitely in Prometheus.
title: group_metrics stale labels retained indefinitely when cardinality guard fires
